scope: Static equipment coverage. All model rows already existed in the full reference appendix; this is a focused supplement to the current Vale list, not a claim of newly discovered hundreds of runtime items.
limitations: Class/resource metadata does not execute registration or enumerate NBT-generated variants.
Unused localization-only armor slots are not promoted to real items.
Private Armourers Workshop skins and CustomNPC equipment can add custom appearances; not covered by JAR metadata.
Generic Vale names do not establish character-art parity or one-to-one mappings.
